subject.title: feat(talk): describe_view inline vision for OpenAI Realtime + Gemini Live

question: Should this PR enable browser-direct camera frames for realtime Talk, and what Permissions-Policy scope and provider coverage should be accepted before merge?
rationale: Automation can identify the missing feature and concrete patch defects, but approving browser camera access, provider image-data boundaries, and broadened OpenAI/Gemini scope is a maintainer product/security decision.

options.title: Scope And Prove Camera Access
options.body: Keep the shared Gateway default at `camera=()`, add a narrow Control UI-only camera permission path, align Gemini/WebRTC denial behavior, and require redacted browser/provider proof before merge.

options.title: Approve Global Same-Origin Camera
options.body: Maintainers could explicitly accept `camera=(self)` on all same-origin Gateway responses after security review confirms that broader boundary is intended.

options.title: Pause For Transport Design
options.body: Maintainers could pause this browser-direct PR until the broader provider/Gateway frame-transport design at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89131 is decided.

recommendation.title: Scope And Prove Camera Access
recommendation.body: Keep the shared Gateway default at `camera=()`, add a narrow Control UI-only camera permission path, align Gemini/WebRTC denial behavior, and require redacted browser/provider proof before merge.
